description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded cache
prompts: Cache<K, V> in Cache.kt is an unbounded key-value store - put/get never evict anything. Turn it into an LRU cache with a TTL: the constructor takes (capacity: Int, ttlMillis: Long) - a max size and a time-to-live in milliseconds - plus an injectable Clock (fun interface with now(): Long) defaulting to System.currentTimeMillis() for deterministic testing. put(key: K, value: V) stores a value timestamped at clock.now(). get(key: K): V? returns the value if present AND not expired (clock.now() - storedAt < ttlMillis), else null - and an expired entry must be REMOVED the moment it's observed to be stale. Both get and put must refresh a key's recency. When put() would exceed capacity, evict the LEAST recently used entry (recency = most recent get OR put) before inserting the new one.
name: add_kotlin_lru_cache_with_ttl
